scope: Reader image audit, not expert palaeographic adjudication or a sound/name test. Preserve g/m/y and word-boundary alternatives.
selection: First5 are anchor and already recorded cheg/chem disputes; last3 broaden samehand4 comparison to agreed ypcheg and cheg/cheim or cheg/chey alternatives. All were exposed in v87. No claim of blind discovery.
controls: On each focal page use nearest preceding and nearest following H complete tokens ending m as positive graphic comparators, in source order, preserving actual line position. Also inspect neighbouring line/label endings visible in each crop, without changing source readings. Missing control remains missing; no cross-hand pooling.
inspection: Inspect native-resolution crops with whole word and adjoining context, not only isolated shapes. Describe loop count, vertical/descending strokes, connections, nearby sign variation and available image clarity. Do not infer stroke order or ligature segmentation from static ink. Distinguish allograph candidate, distinct-sign candidate, positional convention candidate and unresolved.
position: Classify each occurrence as single-word unit, first/interior/final source token and paragraph/radial/individual-label format. Final token on circular/radial text is not automatically physical line margin; record separately. Single-word labels are not independent evidence for line-end convention.
corpus_diagnostic: Descriptive H final-g tokens across atlas; F counterpart only at shared source locus with exactly matching token slots and identical whole-word prefix before final character. Retain unalignable/disagreeing prefixes and missing F. Counts diagnose transcription alternatives, not real glyph equivalence. No significance test or broad script normalisation.
preservation: Do not overwrite H/K/V/U anchor agreement with elsewhere F m readings. No global g-to-m merge and no new rarity rescore in this audit. No historical names or sounds fitted.
